description: How tall, deep and wide a desk a person needs, from OSHA's workstation guide: the top at seated elbow height when the keyboard sits on it, at least 24 inches deep for legroom, and wide enough for the monitor; the monitor 20 to 40 inches from the eyes. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

elbow.description: Seated elbow height from the floor, in inches. Default 27.

monitor.description: Monitor size (screen diagonal), in inches; 0 for a laptop only. Default 27.

name: desk_size
title: Desk size calculator
